name: For The Emperor! The Final Charnel Charge & Slaying of Gorgon-Prime

cycle_advancement.world_state: The Sump Charnel Ditches Purged — Apex Bio-Titan Slain

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The twitching, hollowed carcass of the Gorgon-Gargant Matriarch lies smoldering in the sump lake. Black acidic ichor hissed into the drainage flues as the surviving conscripts plant the double-headed Imperial Aquila atop its severed skull.

completed_milestones.title: Bio-Titanic Apex Matriarch Slain in the Sump Ditches
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Kathryn Vane led a glorious, bloody charge into the beast's exposed core; with shotgun slugs and screaming chainsword, the Matriarch Prime was slain. Sector threat eradicated.

active_combat_encounters.tactical_requirements: Threat neutralized. Sump Ditches secured for reclamation.

boss_gorgon_matriarch_prime.name: The Sump Gorgon-Gargant: Matriarch Prime
boss_gorgon_matriarch_prime.threat_status: Decapitated and Heart Pulped in Melee Charge
notable_kills: Matriarch Prime (450 HP): Carapace breached by Bragg and Krak charges; heart-core obliterated at point-blank range by Sergeant Kathryn Vane's Combat Shotgun and Mk VII Chainsword.

decoy_larval_brood_pupa.name: Brood-Larval Decoy Pupa
decoy_larval_brood_pupa.threat_status: Blown to pieces by Krak Grenade
notable_kills: Decoy Husk: detonated by Sergeant Vane's krak charge, unmasking the True Matriarch sleeping below

sump_sewer_scuttlers.name: Sump Sewer-Scuttlers

4 Heavy Armored Scuttlers: skull-pulped by Bone 'ead Bragg's Power Fist
Drainage Swarm (37 scuttlers): concentrated lasfire and Trooper Jax's 2 frag canisters

feral_sump_stalkers.name: Feral Sump Stalkers

sub_units.armament: Kantrael Lasguns, combat knives, scarred flak vests
sub_units.morale: Fanatical (95% — Witnessed the Slaying of the Titan)

combat_med_stims.unit: injector ampoules (-5 emergency field stims applied to Vane, Bragg, Jax)

active_resource_stockpile.quarantine_logistics_alert: VICTORY: Apex Sump Gorgon-Matriarch slain! Charnel Trench cleared. Emergency med-stims administered to officers.

new_decision.decision: Bellowed 'FOR THE EMPEROR!' with every ounce of lung and fury, leaping directly onto the Matriarch's ruptured neck; emptied 24 solid shotgun slugs into its exposed brain stem and drove the screaming Mk VII Chainsword to the hilt, severing its nervous cord and toppling the 20-ton leviathan.
new_decision.impact: Slew the Bio-Titan in personal melee combat; restored command resolve, administered combat stim (+15 Vitality to 55), and unified garrison under fanatical devotion.

new_decision.decision: Witnessed the Sarge plunge the roaring chainsword into the monster's brain; dragged himself up with blood in his teeth, roaring with primal Ogryn triumph as the med-stims flooded his veins.
new_decision.impact: Injected with 2 emergency combat med-stims; stabilized from mortal threshold (Vitality 10 -> 40), surviving as a living legend of the Astra Militarum.

new_decision.decision: Joined the final bayonet surge chanting the Emperor's name through tears and blood; jammed an emergency stim-injector into his neck and pinned the fallen Matriarch's eye with his lasgun barrel.
new_decision.impact: Stabilized by emergency stim-injector (Vitality 5 -> 30); transformed from terrified sump-scum into an unshakable veteran survivor.
